latest_release.name: Release v0.68.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Changelog for v0.67.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29990
* Changelog for v0.66.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29992
* docs(readme): clarify Gemini CLI scope, limitations, and tool landscape by @LyalinDotCom in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29995
* fix(cli): bound inline history re-render after terminal width changes by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29904
* fix(ui): handle surrogate pairs when truncating in sanitizeForDisplay by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29993
* fix(core): make isWithinRoot case-insensitive on Windows by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29999
* fix(core): recognize dotted Gemini 3 models in supportsMultimodalFunctionResponse by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29982
* feat(cli): add extension validation command and evaluation tests by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29980
* fix(core): normalize leading slashes in file search query for @ autocomplete by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29987
* fix(vscode-ide-companion): register all extension disposables in context.subscriptions by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29994
* fix(core): list Auto in /model when dynamicModelConfiguration is enabled and preview access is disabled by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29998
* fix(core,cli): fix instances of incorrect \n escape behavior by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29989
* fix(core): use PowerShell CIM fallback for Windows IDE process lookup by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30006
* fix(cli): surface 429 rate limit cool-down and countdown in loading indicator by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30012
* fix(cli): anchor .git suffix removal to end of repo URL by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30013
* fix(ci,sdk): run SDK tests in PR CI and fix AgentLoopContext mock in session.test.ts by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30023
* fix(core): prevent $-pattern corruption in LLM prompt templates by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30035
* fix(cli): Fixes unexpected truncation and toggle behavior in Expandab… by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29965
* refactor(cli): decouple ToolGroupMessage from internal type guards and payload structures by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30041
* fix(core): gate background log stream initialization on execution lifecycle transition by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30031
* fix(core): honor .git/info/exclude and core.excludesFile in shadow repo by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30034
* fix(core): flush pending SSE event buffer at stream EOF in CodeAssistServer by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30050
* fix(core): handle Windows libuv zero-device stat reporting in readSecureFileBuffer by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30044
* fix(cli): serialize concurrent extension installs with per-extension lock (#29036) by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30039
* fix(core): resolve symlinked paths canonically in GlobTool by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30042
* fix(cli): add missing active and focus keys to custom theme ui schema by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30032
* fix(core,cli): preserve selected model across transient fallback, cancel, and r
